content.short: Zeeverse is a F2P monster-tamer MMORPG set in an indigenous fantasy world.
content.description: Zeeverse is a free-to-play monster-tamer MMORPG that blends engaging PvE and PvP experiences with NFT merge mechanics. Players journey through the mythical Spirit Realm in the role of a budding Shaman, collecting, hatching, and training a crew of companions known as ZEE. These ZEE form the core of your strategy as you pit them in thoughtful, turn-based battles to defend Zeeverse against encroaching, corrupted forces.
content.meta: Zeeverse is a F2P monster-tamer MMORPG with rich PVE and PVP modes and NFT merge mechanics. Discover Zeeverse and other Web3 apps on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
